response.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scanconservation AS c
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT healtheval,
         record_count,
         record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM status_shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT sc.record_count, sc.share, a.average_share
  FROM status_shares AS sc
  CROSS JOIN averages AS a
  WHERE sc.share > a.average_share
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: A NULL healtheval is grouped as one status; conservation records without a matching site are excluded by the inner join. Shares and averages are calculated over the distinct status groups, including the NULL group.
